basis: Explicit provider identity is an immutable source input; no automatic lock repair

cases.name: missing_lock
cases.obligation: Syntax use cannot guess a provider without the explicit request lock

cases.name: missing_default
cases.obligation: A default invocation cannot choose an absent export or another provider

cases.name: stale_source
cases.obligation: A coherent source/grammar lock pair for different source bytes must not authenticate the current provider

cases.name: wrong_grammar
cases.obligation: A correct provider source hash does not repair a mismatched grammar fingerprint

cases.name: duplicate_entry
cases.obligation: Duplicate path/export keys cannot be selected by entry order

cases.name: wrong_rule
cases.obligation: A stale CT language rule is rejected without silently updating the lock
